body:
V7.2 Log Processing
Timely logging is critical for audit events, triage, and escalation. Ensure that the application's logs are clear and can be easily monitored and analyzed either locally or log shipped to a remote monitoring system.

comments.body: I would say it's also duplicate to https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/997#issuecomment-841846770, can carry related discussions there. Closing this one.

title: The 7.2 Title talks about "remote monitoring system" but no requirements in this section addresses it
